# import-fresh [![Build Status](https://example.invalid/sindresorhus/import-fresh.svg?branch=master)](https://example.invalid/sindresorhus/import-fresh)

> Import a module while bypassing the [cache](https://example.invalid/api/modules.html#modules_caching)

Useful for testing purposes when you need to freshly import a module.


## Install

```
$ npm install --save import-fresh
```


## Usage

```js
// foo.js
let i = 0;
module.exports = () => ++i;
```

```js
const importFresh = require('import-fresh');

require('./foo')();
//=> 1

require('./foo')();
//=> 2

importFresh('./foo')();
//=> 1

importFresh('./foo')();
//=> 1
```
